archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) - Modified for GovTech with user-specific brand colors

layout_and_spacing.mobile: Bottom navigation bar (fixed, z-50) + Hamburger menu in top header for overflow links
layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6 for cards). Maintain strict alignment for dense data and clear scanability.
layout_and_spacing.touch_targets: Minimum 44px height/width for all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, nav items) - WCAG AA requirement
layout_and_spacing.card_style: Flat background, 1px subtle border, rounded-xl, no heavy soft shadows. Focus on crisp geometric layout.

components.buttons: Shadcn UI Buttons. Touch-friendly (min-h-[44px]). Solid primary actions use #1E3A8A. Distinct Red/Orange buttons strictly for Emergency Actions.
components.emergency_cards: Visual priority: distinct border-l-4 or solid backgrounds using emergency red/orange colors. Include online/availability status indicator (green dot for available, red for busy). Include 'Hubungi Sekarang' WhatsApp/Tel anchor tags.
components.stats_cards: Clean and minimal. Big numbers (Poppins font), small labels (Inter font). Use Lucide icons to indicate metrics (KK, Penduduk, RT/RW).
components.navigation: Desktop: Vertical sidebar layout. Mobile: Fixed bottom tab bar (Home, Emergency, Info, Profile).
components.scrolling_ticker: Use 'react-fast-marquee' for the pengumuman (announcements) ticker below the header. Keep animation smooth and readable.
components.maps: Embed Google Maps for 'Wilayah' in a rounded-xl container with overflow-hidden.
components.tables_and_lists: Use Shadcn Table for Agenda and download lists (PDF/CSV). Zebra striping optional but clear row borders required.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Darken buttons on hover (hover:brightness-90) and ensure explicit text color definition.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Subtle card lifts (-translate-y-1) on hover for non-emergency cards.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Ensure focus rings are clearly visible (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#1E3A8A]).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Specifically test text over #DC2626 and #EA580C.
accessibility.dark_mode: Fully implement dark mode toggles with Tailwind's 'dark:' variant classes.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='call-ambulance-btn').

image_urls.description: Ambulance for Emergency Response card visual context
City aerial view for the header or main dashboard banner if needed
Community meeting for Kader Info (Posyandu, PKK, Linmas) card images

media.icons_library: lucide-react (Standard crisp icons suitable for GovTech interfaces)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the user's specific brand colors: Primary Blue #1E3A8A, Primary Green #059669, Emergency Red #DC2626, Emergency Orange #EA580C.
Typography MUST strictly use Poppins for Headings/Numbers and Inter for Body text.
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs) have a minimum height of 44px to satisfy mobile touch target accessibility.
Implement a Responsive Layout: Desktop sidebar navigation + main content; Mobile bottom navigation + hamburger menu for overflow.
Build the dashboard using the 'Control Room' grid strategy for high density and scannability, utilizing cards with 1px subtle borders (no muddy shadows).
Emergency contacts MUST have clear one-tap call/WA buttons and a real-time availability status indicator (e.g., green dot for available).
Provide a robust Dark/Light mode toggle, mapping colors to deep slate (not pure black) in dark mode to reduce eye strain.
Ensure PWA (Progressive Web App) offline caching capabilities are established.
Every interactive element and significant widget MUST have a descriptive `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='btn-emergency-ambulance'`).
